holdout: chronological later 30% of capture time; no model fitting or threshold search

atomic.interpretation: At one timestamp, one YES ask plus the complementary NO ask (1 minus YES bid) costs 1 plus the YES spread. Sequential positive outcomes require a favorable later move and are not locked-in arbitrage.

assumptions.sequentialSizing: one share; both top levels must display at least one share
assumptions.fees: zero per challenge research setup; no added slippage beyond walking visible depth

limitations: Public displayed depth is a conditional counterfactual, not an order acceptance or fill; books include own orders and queue priority is unknown.
Sequential positive pair P&L is caused by later price movement, with first-leg directional exposure; it is not same-timestamp arbitrage.
The report has no account holdings, order state, actual fills, or actual cash netting evidence.
Same-time 1% depth sweep uses only the captured visible top 20 levels and does not establish executable capacity after latency.

contractSemantics.identity: Each YES/NO pair is grouped by exact exchangeId and marketId; unrelated markets or contracts never offset each other.
contractSemantics.marketBinary: YES and NO are opposite sides of one binary question; a winning share pays 1 SUSQie.
contractSemantics.oppositePositionNetting: Buying one opposite-side share cancels one held share and credits 1 SUSQie immediately; an uncompleted second leg receives no pair credit.
contractSemantics.selfTrade: An order cannot fill against the same account's opposite resting order; another compatible order is required.
contractSemantics.modeledFees: 0.000000 SUSQies per share, consistent with this challenge’s fee-free test assumption. The public product guide does not state a separate per-fill fee schedule.
